description: This Java source file defines a Wear OS watch face service that visualizes the peek card bounds by drawing a border around the peeking card area. It demonstrates interaction with the WatchFaceStyle and handling peek card position updates.

classes.name: CardBoundsWatchFaceService
classes.description: A watch face service that detects the peek card position and visualizes it.

methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the watch face engine.

inner_classes.name: Engine

methods.description: Initializes the engine and sets the watch face style.

methods.name: onPeekCardPositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates the stored bounds of the peek card and triggers redraw.
